mapper.select: SELECT INST_CD AS INST-MAST-CD, INST_STAT AS INST-MAST-STAT, FEE_RATE AS INST-MAST-FEE-RATE FROM TB_INST_MASTER WHERE INST_CD = #{DCL_TB_INST_MASTER.INST-MAST-CD}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STG_TRX (TRX_DATE, TRX_SEQ, INST_CD, ACC_NO, TRX_TYPE, TRX_AMT, FEE_AMT, PROC_STAT) VALUES (#{DCL-TB-STG-TRX.STG-TRX-DATE}, #{DCL-TB-STG-TRX.STG-TRX-SEQ}, #{DCL-TB-STG-TRX.STG-INST-CD}, #{DCL-TB-STG-TRX.STG-ACC-NO}, #{DCL-TB-STG-TRX.STG-TRX-TYPE}, #{DCL-TB-STG-TRX.STG-TRX-AMT}, #{DCL-TB-STG-TRX.STG-FEE-AMT}, #{DCL-TB-STG-TRX.STG-PROC-STAT})
